name: Wolf Swapping - Arctic Wolf
summary: "Wolf Swapping - Arctic Wolf" is an exchange arrangement offered by Ogunaro Wolfrunner in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. Riders who possess one of the older fast wolves can trade their mount horn for an Arctic Wolf from the newly trained breeding stock. It allows veteran Horde riders to adopt a wolf with a distinct appearance without losing their riding speed.

sections.title: A Change of Mount
sections.body: In the Valley of Honor, kennel master Ogunaro Wolfrunner oversees the breeding and training of the Horde's war wolves. With the arrival of newly bred swift wolves to the yards, Ogunaro offers an open trade to seasoned orcish riders. Anyone returning with an older swift mount can swap their horn for one of the newer lineage, including the pale-coated Arctic Wolf.

sections.title: The Valley's New Pack
sections.body: The wolves pacing the paddocks in Orgrimmar represent generations of selective rearing since the Horde arrived on Kalimdor. While earlier swift wolves proved their speed on the march, the new stock exhibits striking visual variations and rugged builds suited to the harsh climates of Azeroth. Ogunaro guarantees that the new arctic beast runs just as swiftly as the wolf traded in.

faq.q: Who offers the Wolf Swapping exchange?
aliases: where to turn in old wolf
faq.answer: Ogunaro Wolfrunner, the wolf breeder and riding trainer stationed by the kennels in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, handles the swap.

faq.q: What do I need to trade for the Arctic Wolf?
faq.answer: You need to present Ogunaro with one of the older swift wolf mount horns. In return, he provides the Horn of the Arctic Wolf from his newer pack.

faq.q: Is the Arctic Wolf slower than my old mount?
faq.answer: No. Ogunaro confirms that the wolves of the new pack are just as fast as the veteran mounts they replace, differing only in breed and physical appearance.

faq.q: Can Alliance characters trade for this wolf?
faq.answer: No. The kennel and its mounts belong exclusively to the Horde, and Ogunaro Wolfrunner only conducts business with loyal Horde riders.

faq.q: Can I see what the Arctic Wolf looks like before trading?
aliases: what does the wolf look like
faq.answer: Yes. Ogunaro keeps representatives of the swift breeds around the yard in the Valley of Honor so riders can inspect the pack before making an exchange.

faq.q: Why is Ogunaro swapping wolves in the first place?
faq.answer: Ogunaro introduced a new generation of swift wolves to the Orgrimmar yards and allows veteran riders who purchased the earlier swift breeds to trade for the newer appearances.

angles.text: Orcs have bonded with wolves since their origins on Draenor, and Ogunaro's kennels continue that tradition right in the heart of Durotar.
The war wolves trained in Orgrimmar serve as foundational mounts for the Horde's cavalry forces across Kalimdor.
